theme_and_identity.archetype: Organic & Earthy mixed with Swiss High-Contrast
theme_and_identity.vibe: Grounded, matte, physical, calming but highly structured. Designed to reduce cognitive load and anxiety. The Anti-Distraction Engine.

rules: Use Cabinet Grotesk for all Headings (H1-H4).
Use Manrope for body text, UI labels, and inputs.
Overlines/Labels MUST be Uppercase, text-xs, tracking-[0.2em] with text_secondary color.
Do NOT use Inter for headings.

general: Generous spacing: Use p-6, p-8, or p-12 for main containers to give breathing room.
App structure: Use a collapsible left-sidebar navigation instead of a top nav for the dashboard layout.
Dashboard Grid: Use High Density Grid for the main view (grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4) with gap-6.
Optical Alignment: Ensure elements look balanced, not just mathematically centered.
Avoid 100% full-width content on ultra-wide screens; cap main content area at max-w-7xl.
components: Cards: Flat solid surfaces. 1px subtle border (border-border), max rounded-xl (12px) radius. Use soft, organic shadows only on hover.
Header/Nav: Solid background with a hard 1px bottom border. NEVER use transparent header if content scrolls underneath.
Sidebar: Subdued background, distinct from main content area to establish clear spatial hierarchy.

visual_enhancers.surfaces: Use Neumorphism (Tactile) variant sparingly for small widgets. Mostly rely on crisp 1px borders (Grid Borders style) for data-heavy sections.
visual_enhancers.textures: Apply a very subtle noise overlay (opacity 2-3%) on the main background to kill digital flatness.
visual_enhancers.motion: Staggered entrance animations for task lists (framer-motion). Hover states should subtly lift (-translate-y-0.5) and slightly darken borders.

component_instructions.Shadcn: Use Shadcn components for complex logic (Tables, Select, Dialog, Calendar). Strip away default Vercel look and apply our earthy/matte styling.
component_instructions.Charts: Use Shadcn charts (Recharts) for analytics. Ensure they use the brand accent colors (Moss Green, Terracotta) rather than generic blue/purple.
component_instructions.Toasts: Use Sonner for toast notifications, configured to appear at bottom-right.
component_instructions.Icons: Use lucide-react (default). Maintain consistent stroke width. NEVER use emojis.

feature_specific_designs.dashboard: Top-Left quadrant shows 'North Star' metric (Goal Progress). Use progressive disclosure—hide dense lists behind tabs.
feature_specific_designs.tasks_management: Use a crisp list view with staggered animations. High priority tasks can use the Terracotta accent.
feature_specific_designs.ai_coach_sidebar: Differentiate the AI chat area visually using a slightly darker/subdued background color to feel like a 'drawer' or separate dimension.
feature_specific_designs.notes_journal: Full-width editor area with large, airy margins. Default to Manrope text-lg with leading-relaxed.

accessibility_and_testing.contrast: Ensure minimum 4.5:1 ratio for normal text. Use APCA guidelines.
accessibility_and_testing.testing: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute in kebab-case based on role (e.g., data-testid='create-task-button').

empty_states.description: Stack of white zen stones on seashore
empty_states.placement: Use for 'Zero Goals' or 'All caught up' empty state to reinforce calm/focus.

auth_background.placement: Use as a high-quality side image for the Login/Signup split screen.

avatars.placement: Sample user avatar in the profile sidebar/header.
Secondary user avatar or AI persona representation.

UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. In frontend design, this creates the 'AI slop' aesthetic. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
You MUST NOT apply universal transition (e.g., transition: all). Always add transitions for specific interactive elements.
You MUST NOT center align the app container, i.e., do not add .App { text-align: center; } in the css file.
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped, or sharp button with interaction animations & color relevant to the app style.
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 etc for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, entrance animations. Static = dead.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui when applicable.
Use sonner for toasts, located in /app/src/components/ui/sonner.js (or equivalent jsx).
All interactive elements MUST include data-testid.
Do NOT use transparent backgrounds on headers over content.
This project uses .js/.jsx files, NOT .tsx. Adapt your imports and component structure accordingly, avoiding TypeScript types.
